
```{r}
# import data
concat_rna <- read_table("Concat rma no AFFX.txt", col_types = cols())
```

```{r}
# keep all rows from concat_rna and match rows from all_attribute
df <- left_join(concat_rna, all_attribute, by = "barcode") |> 
  filter(ORGAN_ID == "Liver") |> # only need liver data

head(df)
```

# Hierarchical clustering of genes based on expression levels under zero exposure.

```{r}
# a.Extract both expression and phenotypic data and subset to baseline samples (dose= 0 mg/kg).
df_baseline <- df |> 
  filter(DOSE == 0)
```

```{r}
# b.Transpose the expression data, calculate the standard deviation for each gene and filter out genes with variance below the median.

# To get only the gene expression data
df_expression <- df_baseline |> 
  select(ends_with("_at"))

# Transpose the expression data
df_expression_t <- t(df_expression)

# Standard deviation of each row and column
sds <- colSds(df_expression_t)

# Filtering variance > median variance across genes
df_expression_t_filter <- df_expression_t[, sds > median(sds)]

# Similarity measure: use absolute correlation between genes 
cormat = cor(xt_filter)

# distance
d = 1 - abs(cormat)

# Hierarchical clustering
#hclust_complete = hclust(as.dist(d), method = "complete")

#plot(hclust_complete, labels = FALSE)

hclust_ward = hclust(as.dist(d), method = "ward.D2")

dendro_plot = plot(hclust_ward, labels = FALSE)
```

# K-means clustering of genes based on change in expression following exposure.

```{r}
# 1.Calculate the mean expression for control samples (does = 0 mm/kg) by COMPOUND_NAME and duration
control_mean <- df |> 
  filter(DOSE == 0) |> 
  relocate(DOSE, COMPOUND_NAME, duration) |> 
  #group_by(COMPOUND_NAME, duration) |> 
  group_by(COMPOUND_NAME, duration) |> 
  summarize(across(ends_with("_at"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
  
head(control_mean)
```

```{r}
# 2.Calculate the mean expression for exposed samples (does ≠ 0 mm/kg) for each compound by grouping the same variables as above plus “compound”.
compound_mean <-  df |> 
  filter(DOSE != 0) |> 
  #relocate(COMPOUND_NAME, duration) |> 
  group_by(COMPOUND_NAME, duration) |> 
  summarize(across(ends_with("_at"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

head(compound_mean)
```

```{r}
# 3.Calculate the difference in mean expression between control and exposed samples by grouping the same variables as in step 1.
mean_diff <- control_mean |> 
  inner_join(compound_mean, join_by(COMPOUND_NAME, duration), suffix = c("_control", "_exposed")) |> 
  mutate(across(ends_with("_control"), ~ . - get(sub("_control", "_exposed", cur_column())), .names = "diff_{col}"))

head(mean_diff)
```

```{r}
# 4.Filter out the genes with a variance lower than the median variance across genes.

# Compute variance for each gene (selecting only diff_ columns)
gene_var <- mean_diff |> 
  select(starts_with("diff_")) |> 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ var(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

# Compute median variance
median_var <- median(unlist(gene_var), na.rm = TRUE)

# Select genes with variance above the median
high_var_genes <- names(gene_var)[unlist(gene_var) > median_var]

# Keep grouping columns + high-variance genes
grouping_cols <- c(COMPOUND_NAME, duration)

filtered_mean_diff <- mean_diff |> 
  select(all_of(high_var_genes))

head(filtered_mean_diff)
```

```{r}
# 5.Use the Elbow method to find the optimal number of clusters.
# transpose the filtered_mean_diff
filtered_mean_diff_t <- t(filtered_mean_diff)

cluster_data <- filtered_mean_diff_t

#remove rows with missing values
cluster_data <- na.omit(cluster_data)

#scale each variable to have a mean of 0 and sd of 1
cluster_data <- scale(cluster_data)

#create plot of number of clusters vs total within sum of squares
fviz_nbclust(cluster_data, kmeans, method = "wss")
```

```{r}
# 6) Perform K means clustering of genes based on change in expression following exposure.

# Perform K-means clustering 
set.seed(123)  # For reproducibility
k <- 3 # Optimal number of cluster
km <- kmeans(cluster_data, centers = k, nstart = 25)
```


```{r}
# use a for-loop to process clusters 1..k
for (c in seq_len(k)) {
  cat("\n=== K-means cluster", c, "===\n")
  
  # Genes in cluster c
  cluster_genes <- rownames(cluster_data)[km$cluster == c]
  
  # If the cluster has fewer than 2 genes, skip
  if (length(cluster_genes) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping cluster", c, "because it has < 2 genes.\n")
    next
  }
  
  # Subset the transposed matrix to these genes
  # rows = genes, columns = observations
  submat_t <- cluster_data[cluster_genes, , drop = FALSE]

  cor_mat <- cor(submat_t, method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  
  # 3.1b) Optionally convert correlation to distance
  dist_mat <- as.dist(1 - abs(cor_mat))
  
  # 3.1c) Hierarchical clustering on that distance
  hc <- hclust(dist_mat, method = "ward.D2")
  
  # 3.1d) Heatmap: The matrix to plot is the correlation matrix (genes x genes)
  pheatmap(
    cor_mat,
    cluster_rows = hc,
    cluster_cols = hc,
    # Alternatively,can let pheatmap do "distance = 1 - correlation" automatically,
    main = paste("Gene-to-Gene Correlation - K-means Cluster", c),
    show_rownames = FALSE, # set to TRUE if want to see gene labels
    show_colnames = FALSE
  )
}
```
